entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. My name is Velma. How can I assist you today?
Yes, hello. I'm calling about a VeloBand Pulse I rented. I'm trying to return it, but it says I'm past the return date and I'm going to be charged! This is ridiculous!
I understand your frustration. Let me look into that for you. Can I get your name and the order number associated with the VeloBand Pulse rental?
It's Sarah Miller. And the order number is VF7892145.

Thank you, Ms. Miller. I see the VeloBand Pulse rental here. According to our records, the rental period ended on October 26th, and today is November 5th. That is past our 10-day return window. Can you tell me what happened?
Well, this VeloBand Pulse was a gift from my sister. She gave it to me just before I left for traveling overseas to visit my family. I got back late last night.
I see. I understand. Traveling internationally can certainly disrupt things. So you only just got back from traveling? I can see how the time got away from you.

Exactly! And to make things even worse, while I was traveling, my mother had a fall and had to go to the hospital. It was all very stressful, so I completely forgot about the return window! I honestly didn't even open it until just now!

Oh my goodness, Ms. Miller, I am so sorry to hear about your mother. That sounds incredibly stressful. I completely understand how this slipped your mind. I wish you and your mother a speedy recovery. Unfortunately, our standard policy is a strict 10-day return window. It's detailed in the fine print on the rental agreement.
Fine print? Seriously? I bet your website crashed when my sister was trying to order it, too. This is so inconvenient! There must be something you can do. I haven't even used the darn thing!

Ms. Miller, I understand your frustration, and I want to help. Given the circumstances you've described – the VeloBand Pulse being a gift, your international travel, and your mother's hospitalization – I'm going to make an exception in this case. I can process the return for you now, and you won't be charged any late fees.
Really? Oh, thank you so much! I really appreciate that.

You're very welcome, Ms. Miller. I've initiated the return process. You'll receive a confirmation email with instructions on how to ship the VeloBand Pulse back to us. Please ensure it's shipped within the next 3 business days to avoid any potential charges. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for your understanding and help. You've been wonderful!
You're very welcome, Ms. Miller. Have a great day, and we hope to see you back at VeloFit soon. Goodbye.
